verdict.rationale: Devin documents a 'Devin Review with Auto-Fix' feature that responds to code review comments, fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures, implying an automated review capability tied to PRs, but the evidence pack gives no detail on how review comments are generated, whether they are inline, or how coverage/setup works for 'every PR'. missing for 10: explicit documentation of inline AI-generated PR comments, configuration for gating every PR, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the review quality.
